Class UcumUnits

java.lang.Object
network.ike.foundation.ike.ucum.UcumUnits
All Implemented Interfaces:
UcumSymbols
public final class UcumUnits extends Object implements UcumSymbols
The UCUM units as the store holds them after import: the atoms and prefixes read back from their records, so that a unit code met later, in a library's quantity, is read by the grammar against the knowledge in the graph, and a composed unit is made on demand, once, identified by its canonical code.
